items.statement: Published pathways that screen at the surgical listing visit and name an owner for abnormal results report more patients treated before surgery and fewer short-notice postponements than pathways that screen at pre-assessment.
items.rationale: Supported by the timing comparison (c1) and the survey of written pathways (c2); a scoping review can chart it without estimating an effect.

items.statement: Few published pathways describe how patients living far from the centre receive intravenous iron.
items.rationale: Suggested by patients' accounts (c4) and a prior scoping review.
items.risks: Grey literature may hold most of these descriptions.

items.statement: Nurse-led clinics are as common as anaesthetist-led clinics in orthopaedic pathways.
items.rationale: Informs staffing of the local clinic.

summary: Three propositions for the review to chart; h1 organises the charting form.
